name: Revival Experiment
clause: For each permanent type, return up to one card of that type from your graveyard to the battlefield.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'for-each-type'; over: 'permanent-types' | 'card-types'; bind: 'chosen-type'; do: Effect[] }  with Filter.isChosenCardType?: boolean
needs.semantics: Iterate the permanent card types (artifact, creature, enchantment, land, planeswalker, battle), binding each one so the body's Filter can say 'a card of that type'. Today `for-each` only iterates objects.
